data.exact_reserve_text: During 2014 the net loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2012 and prior years of account was increased. These increases are set out in the table below together with their effect on ultimate claims reserves.

prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse development in US liability account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Worse than expected claims experienced primarily in the US liability account leading to an increase in claims reserves.

prior_year_events.event_name: Movement in discontinued element of Treaty account
prior_year_events.impact_description: Further movement in the discontinued element of the Treaty account resulting in increased claims reserves.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate strengthened its gross claims reserves for prior years by GBP 23.342m (approximately 8.4% of opening gross reserves), driven predominantly by adverse development in the Liability (US casualty) account and additional movement in the discontinued Treaty element. The Movement in prior year's provision note records increases of GBP 16.719m (Liability) and GBP 6.623m (Treaty), reflecting an upward recalibration of IBNR and adverse claims experience on older years.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2014 the net loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2012 and prior years of account was increased.
The result was affected by worse than expected claims experienced primarily in the US liability account and further movement in the discontinued element of the Treaty account.
The majority of the loss for the year emanates from the liability line of business on the 2013 and prior years of account.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Lines of business no longer written

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year reserve increases are taken from the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note which lists increases by internal class; the note provides amounts but does not explicitly label them 'gross' vs 'net'. These figures have been treated as gross for the purposes of this extraction. No detailed claims development triangle was provided in the available pages to cross-check aggregate PYD.
